name: ZSF_FCST_HEADER
description: This table has the forecast header for each forecast in forecasting application

columns.name: FCST_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Primary Key for the Forecast header, representing a forecast

columns.name: FCST_METRICS_PARTITION_KEY
columns.description: This column will be copied over to the ZSF_FCST_METRICS table, where it will be used as partition key.

columns.name: FCST_SERIES_ID
columns.description: FK to ZSF_FCST_SERIES.FCST_SERIES_ID, this represents the series to which the forecast belongs to

columns.name: FORECAST_NAME
columns.description: Name of Forecast, this is derived from the due date/start date of the forecast

columns.name: FORECAST_TYPE
columns.description: Forecast type. Values could be Revenue / Non-Revenue. Lookup type is zsf_fcst_type.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of Forecast. The first date of the forecast.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End Date of Forecast. The last date of the forecast.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: The date when the forecast is due, after which it will be locked.

columns.name: LAST_REFRESH_DATE
columns.description: Date of last refresh for this particular forecast

columns.name: TERR_HIER_FREEZE_DATE
columns.description: This represents the date after which territory changes will not be considered for the forecast

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of Header, it could be PAST, ACTIVE, FUTURE.

columns.name: LATEST_FLAG
columns.description: Latest Flag indicates if this is the latest forecast for  the period.

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Reference to the GL calendar selected for CRM

columns.name: CORP_CURR_CODE
columns.description: Reference to the corporate currency selected for CRM

columns.name: CORP_CURR_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Reference to the corporate currency selected for CRM

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name from the common calendar for the forecast header

columns.name: FORECAST_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: Sequence number for the forecast in the list of forecasts for the current forecast period

columns.name: DELETE_FLAG
columns.description: This flag is used to indicate if the header needs to be deleted during generation

columns.name: DENORM_VERSION_ID
columns.description: This has a FK reference to ZSF_TERR_HIERARCHY_DN table

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PRODUCT_SNAPSHOT_VER_ID
columns.description: The version of the product snapshot is stored in the header table.

columns.name: FCST_STATUS_QUALIFIER_CODE
columns.description: This qualifies the existing status to provide more granular display status for overview page, namely ACTIVE, NEXT, PREVIOUS

columns.name: FCST_HEADER_JOB_STATUS
columns.description: Column introduced to determine interoperability status between jobs

columns.name: FCST_HEADER_JOB_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Column introduced to determine interoperability status between jobs

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
